name: Buckwheat pancakes
summary: Buckwheat pancakes are a festival food in Đồng Văn, served beside the buckwheat porridge, noodles, cakes, and wine.
origin: The buckwheat festival in Đồng Văn district.
howToEat: Eat them at the festival. They are a separate dish from the bánh tam giác mạch cake.
where: Đồng Văn district, at the festival, typically mid-to-late November.
seoTitle: Buckwheat pancakes at the Ha Giang festival
seoDescription: Buckwheat pancakes are a Đồng Văn festival food, served apart from the bánh tam giác mạch cake. The festival is typically mid-to-late November.
